versions.changelog:
reminder-engine-free v1.0.0

- Initial release of the free one-time reminder creation engine.
- Supports natural time parsing (relative and absolute), input safety validation, single-channel delivery, and confirmation replies.
- Includes modular lifecycle for building robust and secure reminder workflows.
- Provides bash scripts and step-by-step guides for rapid integration and safe usage.
- Chinese-language documentation and usage examples for quick onboarding.
